fullAnalysis: Today's puzzle presents a collection of seemingly unrelated items that share a common interactive element. From modern technology to clothing and recreational facilities, these objects span different categories yet are unified by a fundamental feature. The clues range from everyday office equipment to winter sports venues, suggesting a physical component that enables user interaction and control. The connection becomes clearer when considering how we interface with each item.

I started by listing common attributes of elevators and calculators, thinking about their electronic nature. Looking at dress shirts seemed to point away from technology. I focused on the physical aspects these items share, noting how users interact with them. The breakthrough came when I realized each item requires pressing something to function or access. After spotting the buttons on curling rinks for measuring distances, I knew I was on the right track. Reflecting on bellies and their colloquial 'belly button' name confirmed the common thread: they all feature buttons in different forms and purposes.

The puzzle connects items featuring buttons: elevator control panels, shirt fasteners, curling rink distance markers, calculator keypads, and anatomical belly buttons. Each represents a different type of button serving various purposes.

Today's puzzle revealed how buttons appear in diverse forms across different contexts. From electronic interfaces to clothing fasteners, and from sports equipment to human anatomy, buttons serve various essential functions.

wordHints.Dress shirts: Dress shirt (Formal Garment): A collared shirt with a full-length button closure down the front.
wordHints.Curling rinks: Curling rink (Sports Facility): An ice surface with embedded buttons for measuring shot distances.
wordHints.Calculators: Calculator (Computing Device): A mathematical tool with numerical and function buttons.
wordHints.Bellys: Belly (Body Part): The abdomen featuring a navel commonly called a belly button.

lessons: Consider multiple meanings of everyday terms. The word 'button' has various applications beyond just clothing fasteners.
Look for physical similarities across categories. Items from different fields can share common physical features or interfaces.
Include informal and colloquial terms. Common nicknames like 'belly button' can be crucial to solving the puzzle.
